selector.rationale: Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy best explains the transient ST-segment elevations, new right bundle branch block, and normal coronary arteries without stenosis, along with right ventricular dilatation and elevated pulmonary arterial pressure.

rejected.label: Pulmonary Embolism
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence for pulmonary embolism, such as positive D-dimer or imaging findings, despite some suggestive symptoms.

rejected.label: Acute Coronary Syndrome
rejected.why: Normal coronary angiography results contradict the typical findings of acute coronary syndrome.
